title: No More Import Errors: Constrained Decoding for Guaranteed Valid Imports in LLM-Generated Tests
title_zh: 告别导入错误：用于保证大语言模型生成测试中导入有效性的约束解码

paragraphs.en: CBDL约束束解码保证LLM生成测试的导入有效性，显著提升测试正确率并支持低成本混合生成。 One of the most common failure reasons of LLM-based test generation pipelines is import errors. Grammar constrained decoding can modify the probabilities of the LLM's final layer during token generation to guarantee valid imports. However, we find that it can lead to degenerate solutions, i.e., repetitive valid imports (import streaks) that exhaust the token budget before a test is generated. We propose Constrained Beam Decoding with Lookup (CBDL), a novel method that guarantees import validity while addressing import streaks by avoiding premature commitment to tokens that lead to repetitive imports. Because it operates at the decoding stage, CBDL can be integrated into existing LLM-based test generation pipelines. We implement CBDL for Python and Java and evaluate it on two test generation tasks, showing that generated tests have 100% valid imports, outperforming both static (RAG and LIBRO) and dynamic (Agentic Repair) import-validity approaches that leave 45%, 10%, and 43% of import errors unresolved. CBDL converts on average 14% of initial import errors into functionally correct tests, increasing overall test correctness by 1-4 percentage points over unconstrained generation. Even when import validity does not directly lead to a correct test, it allows agentic repair pipelines to allocate the repair budget to remaining errors, increasing correct tests by 2-7 percentage points for Python and 1-6 for Java. Finally, we show that a hybrid pipeline, where a small local model equipped with CBDL generates imports while the frontier GPT-5.2 model generates the test body, outperforms generating both with GPT-5.2 alone by 1-3 percentage points. Overall, CBDL removes a major bottleneck in LLM-based test generation: by guaranteeing import validity with a small overhead (16-21 seconds per test), it improves test correctness and enables cost-effective hybrid generation.
paragraphs.zh: CBDL约束束解码保证LLM生成测试的导入有效性，显著提升测试正确率并支持低成本混合生成。基于LLM的测试生成流水线最常见的失败原因之一是导入错误。 语法约束解码可以在生成词元过程中修改LLM最后一层的概率，以保证导入有效。 然而，我们发现这可能导致退化解，即重复的有效导入（导入串），在测试生成之前耗尽词元预算。 我们提出带查找的约束束解码（CBDL），这是一种新颖方法，在保证导入有效性的同时，通过避免过早提交会引发重复导入的词元来解决导入串问题。 由于CBDL在解码阶段运作，它可以集成到现有的基于LLM的测试生成流水线中。 我们为Python和Java实现了CBDL，并在两个测试生成任务上对其进行评估，结果表明生成的测试具有100%的有效导入，优于静态方法（RAG和LIBRO）和动态方法（智能体修复），后者分别有45%、10%和43%的导入错误未得到解决。 CBDL平均将14%的初始导入错误转化为功能正确的测试，使整体测试正确率比无约束生成提高1-4个百分点。 即使导入有效性并不直接带来正确的测试，它也能让智能体修复流水线把修复预算分配给剩余的错误，使Python的正确测试增加2-7个百分点，Java增加1-6个百分点。 最后，我们展示了一种混合流水线：由配备CBDL的小型本地模型生成导入，同时由前沿模型GPT-5.2生成测试主体，其效果比单独使用GPT-5.2生成两者高出1-3个百分点。 总体而言，CBDL消除了基于LLM的测试生成中的一大瓶颈：以较小的开销（每个测试16-21秒）保证导入有效性，从而提升测试正确率并实现高性价比的混合生成。
